stories.title: Abu Dhabi talks open: Zelenskyy calls first day 'constructive'
stories.body: US-mediated talks between Russia and Ukraine opened in Abu Dhabi, with Ukraine's delegation led by Rustem Umerov, head of its Foreign Intelligence Service, and Russia's by Vladimir Medinsky. US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff are brokering. President Zelenskyy called the first day constructive and quite substantive. An anonymous US official said both sides had privately shown some flexibility on territory, but this is unconfirmed. Russia occupies roughly 20 percent of Ukraine.
stories.why: A ceasefire would ease world grain and fuel prices that feed Nigerian inflation.

cards.front: Who led Ukraine's delegation at the November 2026 Abu Dhabi talks?
cards.back: Rustem Umerov, head of Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service.

cards.front: Roughly how much of Ukraine does Russia occupy (November 2026)?

stories.title: Trump calls the Iran war 'effectively over', Iran says no
stories.body: After meeting Qatar's Prime Minister, President Trump said the war on Iran is effectively over militarily and the US is keeping the status quo. That includes the naval blockade and a new Task Force Iron Gate to cut Iran's trade by land and across the Caspian Sea. Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei called the remarks fake news, and President Pezeshkian described the situation as neither war nor peace. Iran still demands seven conditions, including lifting sanctions and releasing frozen funds.
stories.why: A frozen 'neither war nor peace' keeps oil supply tight and prices high for Nigeria's fuel imports.

cards.front: What is the US 'Task Force Iron Gate' (November 2026)?
cards.back: A US effort to cut off Iran's trade by land and across the Caspian Sea, alongside the naval blockade.

stories.title: Troops clear camps and arrest suspected gunrunner in Plateau
stories.body: The military said troops of Operation Enduring Peace and 33 Artillery Brigade cleared suspected terrorist camps in Dajin Madam Forest, across Kanam and Wase LGAs, and killed two suspects near Kukawa village. A suspected gunrunner was arrested with an AK-47 at Gindiri Market in Mangu LGA. The details come from a military statement and were not independently verified.
stories.why: Arms trafficking keeps the North-central's farmer-herder and bandit violence going.

cards.front: Which military operation covers Plateau State?

stories.title: Herzog asks Eisenkot to form Israel's next government
stories.body: President Isaac Herzog tasked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government after the 27 October election. Eisenkot's alliance won 48 seats and Netanyahu's bloc 53, both short of 61. Eisenkot has six weeks and said he is open to including Netanyahu. He has ruled out relying on Arab-led parties, which won a record 19 seats. Netanyahu stays caretaker prime minister.
stories.why: A change of Israeli government could affect the Gaza ceasefire and the war with Iran.

cards.front: Who was asked to form Israel's government in November 2026?
cards.back: Gadi Eisenkot, given six weeks by President Herzog.

stories.title: Bandits besiege eight communities in Taraba
stories.body: A community leader said suspected bandits have besieged eight communities in Karim-Lamido LGA, Taraba State, near the borders with Plateau and Bauchi. He said 10 of 15 recently abducted residents had been freed, and alleged the gangs operate from forests in Plateau. Police said they had not yet established the details.
stories.why: It shows banditry spreading from the North-west into the North-east and North-central.

stories.title: Democrats win both houses of the US Congress
stories.body: The Democratic Party won control of both the US House of Representatives and the Senate in the 3 November midterm elections. With counting continuing, Democrats had won 228 House seats and 54 Senate seats, according to AP tallies reported by Al Jazeera. Democrats gained seats in states including Texas, Michigan and Kansas. President Trump remains in office until January 2029, but now faces a Congress controlled by the opposition.
stories.why: Congress shapes US aid, sanctions and security cooperation, including with Nigeria and on the wars in Iran and Ukraine.
